## Trap A–D Editorial & Technical Checklist

- [ ] **Trap A (Masthead & Reprint Audit):** Every `PRIMARY-SCAN-VERIFIED` date was verified on the printed issue masthead, running header, or edition colophon (never unverified bound-volume catalog metadata or later stereotype reprints).
- [ ] **Trap B (Physical Ink vs. OCR):** Every diplomatic transcription was read from page ink at zoom, ruling out broken-type OCR ghosts.
- [ ] **Trap C (Homographs & Proper Names):** Surnames, place names, and unrelated homographs were separated from lexical usage.
- [ ] **Trap D (Epistemic Boundary & Prior Art):** Attested print chronology (*Established in Primary Ink*) is separated from unattested oral/contact reconstruction (*Proposed Origin Mechanism*), internal 4-decimal string scores are omitted from prose, and prior lexicographers (*OED*, *Green's*, *HDAS*, *Etymonline*, *American Speech*, *Comments on Etymology*, ADS-L) are credited generously.
